audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the page's own whys[]: Level 1 read Aurora, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 and 4-5 Tryndamere, Level 6 Aurora.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Skill/Tryndamere/Skill/Skill/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere; whys[0] says Level 1 is even, whys[1] says Level 2 is yours, whys[2]/[3]/[4] all say skill-based.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 realigned in both layers as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The escape the whole page is keyed to had no cooldown number anywhere.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s — the longest cooldown in her kit and by far the biggest window in the lane. Twofold Hex is only 9s at rank 1, so keying your commits to the Q is keying them to nothing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0] and spikes[0].text now state the 22s rank-1 W window and point the commit at it instead of the Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W Spirit Abjuration blink' — Spirit Abjuration is Aurora's PASSIVE, a heal from exorcised spirits. Her W is Across the Veil. The wrong name appeared in spikes[0].text, mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1].
audit.why: Naming the passive as the blink hides two separate facts: the blink is Across the Veil on a 22s cooldown, and the passive is a heal that Grievous Wounds should be timed against.
audit.corrected: All four fields renamed; mid now also states the passive heal and the anti-heal timing.
sources: enemyKit P text and heal flag

audit.why: Across the Veil also turns her invisible on landing, which the page implied only as 'dodge your commits'; spikes[0].text now says invisible outright. Between Worlds is correctly described as a zoning ult rather than burst — Riot's text is a shockwave, a slow field and a teleport across it.

edits.before: Skill-based poke phase: Aurora's Q Twofold Hex and W Spirit Abjuration blink let her chip you and dodge your commit. Punish the moment her W is on cooldown, and don't eat free Q double-hits while walking up to farm.
edits.after: Skill-based poke phase: Twofold Hex curses you and recasts to drag the curse back, and Across the Veil blinks her out invisible on a 22s cooldown. Punish that window, and don't eat free double-hits walking up to farm.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are skill-based. Aurora's Q double-hit poke and W Spirit Abjuration blink let her chip you and dodge your commits, so trades hinge on catching her without W; her R Between Worlds zones rather than bursts, and Undying Rage plus E out of the wall keeps you safe when she commits.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are skill-based. Twofold Hex's recast double-hit chips you and Across the Veil blinks her out invisible, so trades hinge on catching her without W; Spirit Abjuration is her passive heal, so land Grievous Wounds before the long trade, not during it. Between Worlds zones rather than bursts.

edits.before: Bait out W Spirit Abjuration, then commit
edits.after: Bait out W Across the Veil, then commit

edits.before: Blink your commit away with W Abjuration
edits.after: Blink your commit away with Across the Veil

edits.before: Her escape. Crit when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Across the Veil is her 22s escape — engage once it is down or baited.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Twofold Hunt' in spikes[0].text, but the string on disk already reads 'Twofold Hex' — false positive, no action. The page keys focus.text, loading, breakdown.* and most of report[] to Twofold Hex as the tracked cooldown; the ability that actually decides the lane is Across the Veil at 22s.
